shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' app/UserDashboard.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && rg -n \"async function|async \\(|fetch\\(|no-store|force-dynamic|connection\\(\" app --glob '*.tsx' --glob '*.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md && sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git log --oneline -8 -- app/UserDashboard.tsx app/page.tsx && git diff -- app/UserDashboard.tsx app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' CLAUDE.md && sed -n '1,220p' GEMINI.md && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:app/UserDashboard.tsx && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/UserDashboard.tsx tsconfig.json'
